variant_types.step_down: Simplified version — smaller numbers, fewer steps
variant_types.step_up: Harder version — larger numbers, extra constraints

notes: Original questions need correct_answer verification (currently set to first choice as placeholder)
Variant questions need answer recalculation (choices are inherited from originals, not recomputed)
Visual questions (needs_visual=true) need SVG generation from PDF images
Topic split files also available: benjamin_topic{1-8}_{name}.json
